apps.name: YouMod
apps.subtitle: YouMod with extra YouTube tweaks
apps.localizedDescription: YouMod is a YouTube tweak by Tonwalter888. This community-distributed YouProEXTRA IPA includes YouMod and additional player tweaks, such as picture-in-picture and quality controls. The distributor warns that bundled tweaks may be unstable on newer YouTube versions; see the release notes for the current features. Requires iOS 17.0+. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.43.5 | YouMod extra tweaks | YouMod_21.43.5_2.0.0

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!

> [!NOTE]
> - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K60HDR is available.
> - [v2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/Tonwalter888/YouMod/releases/tag/v2.0.0)
> - no standalone iSponsorBlock. (unstable in newer builds)
> - Liquid Glass Support
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`

> [!WARNING]
> - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
